title: Orthogonal Steering and Delay Organize the Phase Structure of Flocking

contributions.purpose: 提出AVES连续时间机制化集群运动框架
contributions.mechanism: 各向异性视觉(带遮挡)过滤感知,经有限反应延迟后作用,把转向线索正交投影到航向法平面,受lift-gravity曲率上限ωmax=g·tanφ/s约束,速度按能量预算自适应
contributions.evaluation: 定性/理论:给出形式化方程与order parameter,正文未报任何实际仿真结果表
contributions.domain: 集群运动/主动物质动力学
contributions.source_quote: We introduce AVES (Anisotropic Vision-Energy-Steering), a continuous-time mechanistic framework in which sensory inputs are filtered by anisotropic vision with occlusion, acted upon after a finite reaction delay

contributions.purpose: 使机制参数从轨迹可统计辨识
contributions.mechanism: 把延迟嵌为有限维增广状态(ring buffer),连续-离散EKF/UKF+仿真推断,四个无量纲控制共享观测模型
contributions.evaluation: 定性:声称反应延迟/bank/交互范围/视锥半角可辨识且跨物种可比,无实测辨识结果
contributions.source_quote: This delay-aware state-space representation makes the four dimensionless controls... statistically identifiable from trajectories and comparable across species and habitats

contributions.purpose: 给出机制关联的可检验相位预测
contributions.mechanism: social delay number S=k_align·τ设定延迟诱导Hopf边界;曲率上限限制milling(rmin=s^2/gB)
contributions.evaluation: 定性理论预测:窄视野/长延迟扩大间歇与碎片化regime,严格roll限制抑制milling
contributions.source_quote: The theory yields testable predictions--e.g., narrower vision or longer delay expand intermittent/fragmented regimes while stricter roll limits suppress milling

self_declared_provenance.quote: This orthogonal-steering projection is biomechanical rather than perceptual: it differs from "projected-view" perception models that operate in image space [9], and instead guarantees that only physically feasible rotations are executed given roll authority and lift-gravity balance.
